info.name: ShopEasy API
info.description: ShopEasy catalog, admin inventory, guest checkout, customer JWT sessions, saved carts, and order-specific tracking. Use an isolated MongoDB Atlas database or replica set. Set adminUsername and adminPassword in the environment. The runner creates temporary products and leaves test orders and customers for inspection. Cloudinary upload is optional.
